tapps-mcp.instructions: TRIGGER POINTS — call these proactively, not reactively: (1) session start → tapps_session_start; (2) before using an unfamiliar library API → tapps_lookup_docs(library); (3) after editing any Python file → tapps_quick_check(file_path); (4) before declaring work complete → tapps_validate_changed(file_paths=...); (5) before refactor/delete → tapps_impact_analysis(file_path); (6) final verification → tapps_checklist(task_type). Memory goes through tapps_memory on this server (bridge-only — no direct tapps-brain MCP entry).

docs-mcp.instructions: Documentation MCP: epic/story generators, Linear issue validation, and planning helpers for Markdown docs in this repo.
